artifactLines: Spring entrance — the settle IS the character.
Overshoot — squash on landing, stretch on rise.
Per-path stagger — forty-seven paths, one wave.

yourTurn.command: Take my logo SVG, run it through spring entrance, draw-on stroke, and stagger — and tell me which one reads as deliberate versus which one just looks busy.
